The role is mainly focused on RUN and operational activities , ensuring the availability, performance and resilience of the virtualization infrastructure while supporting OS and application teams. Administer and support Nutanix AHV, AOS, Prism Element and Prism Central. Contribute to VMware environment operations when required. Monitor platform health, performance, capacity and availability. Troubleshoot issues affecting hosted workloads and infrastructure services. Support OS and application teams on virtualization-related incidents. Infrastructure Monitoring & Incident Management Monitor infrastructure alerts, logs and performance indicators. Investigate incidents and conduct root cause analysis. Participate in incident, problem and change management processes. Coordinate with infrastructure, network, storage and backup teams during major incidents. Escalate complex issues to vendors or engineering teams when required. Capacity & Lifecycle Management Monitor resource utilization across compute, storage and networking layers. Identify capacity constraints and contribute to infrastructure planning. Perform platform maintenance activities, upgrades and patching. Execute Nutanix lifecycle activities, including AOS, AHV and firmware upgrades. Validate platform health following maintenance operations. Resilience, Backup & Recovery Maintain cluster availability and resilience. Support disaster recovery, business continuity and backup activities. Participate in recovery tests and resilience validation. Support storage and backup integration with virtualization platforms. Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and maintain automation scripts using technologies such as PowerShell, Bash, Ansible or REST APIs. Automate operational and monitoring tasks where appropriate. Improve procedures, documentation and operational efficiency. Contribute to standardization and continuous improvement initiatives. Security & Compliance Apply security and hardening standards. Manage platform access according to security policies. Ensure changes comply with operational and compliance requirements. Maintain accurate technical documentation. Required Qualifications Minimum 2 years of experience in infrastructure, virtualization or systems administration. Mandatory hands-on experience with Nutanix AHV. Good knowledge of Nutanix AOS, AHV and Prism. Experience operating and troubleshooting virtualization environments. Understanding of compute, storage and networking concepts. Experience with monitoring, incident management and infrastructure support. Knowledge of high availability, backup, replication and disaster recovery concepts. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional technical teams. VMware vSphere experience is considered an advantage. Nice-to-Have Skills Nutanix certifications (NCA, NCP). Nutanix LCM, Move, Replication or Metro Availability. Enterprise backup solutions (e.g. Veeam). PowerShell, Bash, Ansible or REST APIs. ITIL-based operational environments. VMware vSphere. Kubernetes or OpenShift exposure. Experience with automation, observability or cloud technologies. Profile We are looking for a hands-on and motivated infrastructure engineer with a strong interest in virtualization technologies and continuous learning. The ideal candidate is proactive, curious, collaborative and eager to develop expertise in Nutanix AHV and enterprise infrastructure operations while working alongside experienced engineering teams. General Information Location: Luxembourg Workload: Full-time Start Date: ASAP Language: English required, French is an asset On-call participation may be required Working Model: Infrastructure Operations / RUN

Our foundation is built on safety, teamwork, excellence, respect & sustainability. These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we grow. We value passion, motivation, and strong problem‑solving skills, and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. We’re not here to keep up—we’re here to lead. Role Overview The Preconstruction Manager (EU) acts as the strategic custodian of major infrastructure projects throughout the CRM lifecycle — from tender engagement to MCA signing and operational handover. This role ensures that client needs are met, early-stage agreements (LOI, PCSA, LNTP) are properly managed, and internal teams are aligned for seamless project mobilisation. The Director leads cross-functional coordination, resource planning, and client engagement during preconstruction, acting as a senior interface between Estimating and Operations. Key Responsibilities Oversee project progression through CRM Stages 2–6, ensuring all client requirements are captured and addressed. Lead project familiarisation at Stage 2, aligning bid strategy with client expectations and delivery feasibility. Act as Project Director during Stages 3–5, managing post-tender clarifications, feedback, and early-stage agreements (LOI, PCSA, LNTP). Ensure adequate resources are allocated to meet client needs during preconstruction and early design mobilisation. Coordinate internal updates and communications across Bid, Design, Commercial, and Delivery teams. Work closely with Business Development, Bid Directors, and Estimating teams to ensure strategic alignment and scope clarity. Review Employers Requirements, contract terms, and technical documentation to identify risks, obligations, and opportunities. Liaise directly with clients on Commercial, Technical, Programme, and Contractual matters, acting as a senior point of contact. Ensure all pre-MCA activities are compliant, commercially sound, and technically robust. Lead the structured handover to Operations post-MCA signing, typically over a 3–4 month transition window. Maintain supervisory oversight during handover, supporting Operations and elevating client concerns where required. Contribute to continuous improvement of the CRM process, handover protocols, and Development team workflows. Qualifications & Experience Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline (Chartered status preferred). 10+ years’ experience in project development, bid leadership, or strategic delivery roles within infrastructure or energy sectors. Proven track record managing complex preconstruction phases, client negotiations, and early-stage agreements. Strong understanding of LOI, PCSA, LNTP, and MCA frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional teams across commercial, technical, and operational domains. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Zoho), project lifecycle tools, and handover methodologies. Solid understanding of contract structures, ER reviews, and technical scope integration. An experienced Project Director with strong client-facing capabilities would be ideally suited to this role. Key Competencies Strategic Planning & Business Acumen Aligns Preconstruction with organisational goals and market trends. Strong grasp of financial modelling, margin spread, and risk management. Understands regulatory frameworks and compliance obligations. Project Management - Expertise Skilled in PMI, PRINCE2, Agile methodologies. Proficient in scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation across multi-phase projects. Technical Knowledge - Deep understanding of construction standards, renewable technologies, and IT systems across jurisdictions. Familiar with design, engineering, and procurement workflows. Leadership & People - Management Leads cross-functional teams with clarity and purpose. Strong stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and mentoring capabilities. Risk & Quality - Management Proactively identifies and mitigates risks. Ensures compliance with safety protocols and quality standards throughout preconstruction and handover. Communication & Influence - Presents confidently to senior leadership and clients. Influences decisions and manages complex stakeholder relationships with diplomacy. Innovation & Problem-Solving Champions innovation in project delivery and sustainability. Develops creative solutions to technical and logistical challenges. Digital & Analytical Skills - Proficient in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera). Uses data and analytics to drive performance and decision-making. What We Offer Strategic leadership role influencing major infrastructure projects across Europe. Collaborative, high-performance environment with strong cross-functional engagement. Hybrid working flexibility and competitive compensation. Opportunities for professional development and leadership growth.
